description: Ministry of Water Supply and Estate Infrasturcture Development - The Construction of Katuwangoda Water Treatment Plant under Matara Stage V Water Supply Project - The Construction of Water Storage Tank Pump House and Official Recidence under Kolonna-Balangoda Water Supply Project
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains two orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving and rescinding the acquisition of specific land parcels for water treatment plant and water supply infrastructure projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land properties, their locations, boundaries, and claimants, making it clearly focused on land and property-related matters that fall under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
